$description: AgentOS Design System Skeleton component spec — Ant Design loading placeholder families for content, avatar, button, and input

layers.name: wrapper
layers.role: vertical auto-layout frame for avatar + body; visibility via ShowAvatar

layers.name: avatar
layers.role: optional avatar placeholder block; shape and size via properties

layers.name: body
layers.role: vertical auto-layout frame for title + paragraph skeletons

layers.name: title
layers.role: optional title placeholder bar; width via TitleWidth

layers.name: paragraph
layers.role: vertical stack of paragraph rows; row visibility and widths via ParagraphRows and RowWidth props

titleHeight.reason: Ant Skeleton component token titleHeight = 16; no local foundation token

paragraphRowHeight.reason: Ant Skeleton component token paragraphLiHeight = 16; no local foundation token

paragraphMarginTop.reason: Ant Skeleton component token paragraphMarginTop = 28; no local foundation token

width.reason: Standalone Skeleton.Button width is customizable and not tokenized; use Ant default preview width
Standalone Skeleton.Button width is customizable and not tokenized; use Ant default preview width
Standalone Skeleton.Button width is customizable and not tokenized; use Ant default preview width
Standalone Skeleton.Input width is customizable and not tokenized; use compact preview width
Standalone Skeleton.Input width is customizable and not tokenized; use Ant default preview width
Standalone Skeleton.Input width is customizable and not tokenized; use expanded preview width

titleWidth.reason: Ant default title width is percentage-based and content-driven

paragraphDefaultRows.reason: Ant Skeleton paragraph row count is content-dependent

paragraphLastRowWidth.reason: Ant default last-row width is percentage-based and content-driven

active.effect: linear shimmer left-to-right using baseFill -> highlightFill -> baseFill

notes.scope: v1 covers Skeleton, Skeleton.Avatar, Skeleton.Button, and Skeleton.Input. Skeleton.Image and Skeleton.Node are follow-up specs because they need different geometry and icon/content treatment.
notes.content: Main Skeleton composes optional avatar, title, and paragraph placeholders. These are best represented with Figma BOOLEAN/TEXT properties, not exploded into variant axes.
notes.active: Ant active shimmer is approximated through the shared Neutral/Fill tokens already present in the design system.

figmaConventions.variableMode: Never set explicit Light/Dark mode on component appearance — inherit from file or page context.
figmaConventions.pageContent: Component pages contain only component sets — no text labels, showcase matrices, doc frames, or instance grids.

figmaImplemented.note: Initialized on the Skeleton page in the AgentOS Design System file. v1 prioritizes variant coverage and token bindings; metadata-only width/row text properties remain intentionally unimplemented.

figmaConventions.variantLayout: Page: Content set on top, Avatar below, Button below, Input below with 120px gaps. Inside each set: Active columns, then shape/size sub-columns where applicable.

gaps.name: skeletonComponentTokens
gaps.reason: Ant exposes blockRadius, titleHeight, paragraphLiHeight, and paragraphMarginTop as component tokens, but the local design system does not yet provide dedicated Skeleton foundation tokens.

gaps.name: exactShimmerGradient
gaps.reason: The Ant shimmer uses dedicated gradient color tokens; v1 approximates them with Neutral/Fill/colorFillContent and Neutral/Fill/colorFill.

gaps.name: imageAndNodeSubcomponents
gaps.reason: Skeleton.Image and Skeleton.Node need distinct geometry/content models and are intentionally excluded from v1.

gaps.name: contentWidthPercentages
gaps.reason: Title and paragraph widths are percentage-based/content-driven values, not existing local tokens.

gaps.name: metadataTextProperties
gaps.reason: Figma v1 does not expose TitleWidth, ParagraphRows, LastRowWidth, or WidthValue as TEXT component properties; these remain spec-level metadata for a follow-up pass.
